Name: Aimon's Small Forest Farm
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][i][color=#fce5cd]A tidy and lively forest themed farm, with qql changes, tweaks and additions![/color][/i][/font][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Big thanks to salami5164 (Discord) for commissioning me on this map and encouraging to upload it on Nexus![/b][/font][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]This map inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8192]Tiny Garden Farm[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14117]Tiny Wild Farm[/url]﻿, check them out![/font][/size]
[line]
[/center]
[center][u][u][b][img]https://imgur.com/5nfFjjv.png[/img] [/b][/u][/u][/center]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Tidy and overgrown Foraging themed farm[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Custom starter Giftbox:[/b] Choose starting bonus items before creating a new save file (available in mod's configs).[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b] Better Farm fishing:[/b] catch different fish types in farm, depends on water type (mountain, forest/river and secret woods pools are available)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Map Shortcuts:[/b] pathways Secret Woods and Cindersap Forest (behind the Pink Tree), as well as Grandpha's Shed (if SVE is installed) [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Unlockable Minecart:[/b] get access to vanilla minecart system right from your farm.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Hot Spring: [/b]swim in the lake and restore energy.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Respawnable forage and hardwood stumps[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Diggable grass tiles and option to toggle off dirt pahtways[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][center][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS] [b][size=3] Most features are configurable - feel free to open the mod's config menu and tweak it as you like! [/size][/b][/font][/color][/center]
[line]
[center][/center]
[left][/left]
[center][url=https://postimg.cc/Wtyh7j7t][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Wtyh7j7t/config-options.png[/img][/url][/center]

[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][u][b][color=#f9cb9c]NOTE:[/color][/b] [/u]after changing config for ponds and bridge, there still be brook sounds in the ponds area - it will disappear after map reload (after you sleep for 1 day or reload your save file) [/font][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Starter Gift [/b]- Changes the stuff you get from starter gift box (will only work if you start fresh game - choose BEFORE creating new save file.)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Starter Giftbox items available: [/font][/size]
[quote][spoiler][size=3] - Farming - will give you 15 Parsnip Seeds and 1 Sprinkler
﻿- Foraging -  will give you 10 Carrot seeds, 3 Field Snacks and 1 Forager's Hat
﻿- Fishing -  will give you 1 CrabPot and 1 Training Rod
﻿- Combating -  will give you 1 Wooden Blade and 3 Cherry Bombs
﻿- Ranching -  will give you 20 Hay and 3 Cookies
﻿ ﻿- Floristing -  will give you 9 Tulip Seeds, 9 Jazz Seeds and 1 Fedora Hat
﻿ ﻿- Jojaing -  ???  [/size][/spoiler]
[/quote][/*]
[/list][b][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#b6d7a8]Visuals:[/color][/font][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]  [b]Mist Effect [/b]- adds mist overlay during rain.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]  [b]Shadow Overlay[/b] - adds extra lights and shadows near map's borders. [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]  [b]Canopy Shadows[/b] - adds decorative shadows near foliage overlay.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS] [b] Dynamic Lightrays[/b] - MMAP feature. Adds animated lightrays to farm.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]  [b]Fireflies[/b] - MMAP feature. Adds fireflies to farm.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][b][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#b6d7a8][size=3]Map Tweaks:[/size][/color][/font][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS] [b] Hot Spring [/b]- adds hot spring entrance to bottom lake with dock.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]  [b]Top Pond[/b] - removes lake above the farmhouse.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]  Bottom Pond[/b] - removes bottom lake with dock.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]  [b]Ground Bridge[/b] - replaces wooden bridge to greenhouse with ground tiles.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]  Dirt Pahts[/b] - replaces dirt roads with grass tiles.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]  Minecart[/b] - adds minecart to farm which is connected to vanilal minecart system.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]  [b]Spouse Patio Tiles[/b] - replaces stone tiles with grass in spouse patio areas. Does not affect spouse patio mechanics.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS] [b] SVE Grandpha's Shed Shortcut [/b]- adds shortcut to Grandpha's Shed if SVE is installed.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]  Forest Shortcut[/b] - adds shortcut to Forest (warps you to the tile behind the Pink Tree with swings.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Don't want respawnable stumps? 
[/b]1. Go to:
[/font][/size]
[code]Stardew Valley\Mods(TestNew)\[Testing]\Aimon's Small Forest Farm[/code][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]2. Delete folder named:
[/font][/size]
[code]"[FTM] Small Forest Farm" [/code][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]3. Done![/font][/size]
[line]

[center][img]https://imgur.com/GqZYehL.png[/img][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8]Compatible [/color][/b]with expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarpe, ect...[/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8]Compatible[/color][/b] with any recolors and retextures. [/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#ea9999][b]Not compatible[/b][/color] with any other mod that edits the Foraging Farm (if you use Vanilla Farm replacement version)[/font][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=4][b][u][color=#ffe599]NOTE for SVE compatibility[/color][/u] -[/b][b] the custom Enchanted Grove warp location is [color=#ffe599]x = 74, y = 9[/color] - change it in SVE config.[/b][/size][/b]
[line]
[/center]
[center][size=4][img]https://imgur.com/lMF7LuG.png[/img][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][i][u][color=#ffe599]Note:[/color] [/u][/i]there's 2 versions of this mod :[/b][/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Custom Farm -  [/b]adds new forest farm as custom farm (does not affect vanilla Forest farm).[/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b] Vanilla Farm - [/b]one works as replacement for vanilla Forest farm.
If you start new game -  using Custom version is recommended in order to avoid issues with other farm mods.[/font][/size][/center]

[list=1]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties - MMAP[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Unzip "Aimon's Small Forest Farm" archive into Stardew\Mods folder.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Run the game using SMAPI.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Enjoy.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][line]
[center][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#f9cb9c][size=4]Mods used on screenshots:[/size][/color][/b]
[size=4]----------------------------[/size]
[size=3]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/size]
[size=3]Wildflower Grass[/size]
[size=3]Simple Foliage[/size]
[size=3]Better Water 2[/size]
[size=3]Visible Fish[/size]
[size=3]Vanilla Tweaks[/size][/font][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Cat Valley(Interface)
Stardew Valley Expanded
----------------------------[/font][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#d5a6bd]Thank you for playing[/color]![/b] ❤️
[/font][/size][/center]
